name: New device sign-in
description: Security alert sent when an account is accessed from an unrecognised device or location.
subject: New sign-in to your {{ product.name }} account
preheader: If this was you, no action is needed.

body.default: We noticed a sign-in from a device we haven't seen before. If that was you, there's nothing to do.

details.description: Sign-in provenance. Naming the device, place and time is what lets someone judge whether it was them.

location_caveat.description: Honesty note about IP-based geolocation, which is routinely wrong by a city or more.
location_caveat.default: Location is approximate, based on IP address.

action_url.description: Where to go to secure the account.

security_note.default: If this wasn't you, change your password now and sign out of all devices.
